entries.subject: DAMIT 5955: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-5955.txt. Model 5955, version 2022-02-14, pole (103°, -59°), period 1304.1 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 5.55 ±1.11 km. The thermal effective spherical diameter is used as an approximate volume-equivalent display scale; no joint shape/thermal inversion or independently measured volume is implied.,The5.55 km W2-only diameter has an assumed beaming parameter and at least20% uncertainty; the exceptionally slow spin makes full rotation coverage especially incomplete.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT matches
entries.finding: [Other DAMIT matches](https://damit.cuni.cz/?q=1235) — Inspected for calibrated replacements; retain the selected solution and disclose available alternatives. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 5956: pole (279°, -62°), 1304.1 h, version 2022-02-14. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A model-specific comparison establishes whether an archived alternative improves the selected shape or resolves its pole/scale ambiguity.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown rotation "1304.1 hours" (damit-models) differs from the LCDB V4.0 summary record 1227 period 1265. h (U 3, synodic); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
